Read by the work being done

For the collection's invitation to adopt, combine, or write a different philosophy and form, read Begin with this example, and make something of your own. The following routes describe the maintained Yinyang example.

For ordinary work, the main conversational model reads the common entrypoint, encounter, user model, counterpart and relationship, situated use, and source index completely, reusing current readings. These five accounts are the primary working model. Follow their links into philosophy or private provenance and materials when the question needs depth. When authoring philosophy or its website, give the affected argument and page the sustained attention that task needs, then carry supported changes back to the core accounts; do not substitute the core summary for the work itself. These are formation guides in the distributed package and actual grounded accounts in the situated package, at the same paths.

For formation or revision, read design and revision. For changes to the actual environment, read harness adaptation with the affected personal passages and target. The common methods and resources remain the same in both packages.

This package's essays develop the cultural and philosophical background. They have different roles rather than forming a compulsory sequence:

Relation Reading
Overall purpose and connected argument Stealing fire: model companies and humanity continue acquiring fire; individuals cultivate generative capacities with available fire. The Sun's illumination images a capacity acquired through practice; Sun and Moon express Yinyang's differentiated movement. Individual-first guides how surrounding arrangements adapt to people.
Explicit philosophical claims Core views: the ontology, understanding, and developmental commitments used by the argument.
Method of formation and realization Creation method: how expression, relation, implementation, and evidence inform each other.
How do philosophy, psychology, and personal environment develop together? Trinity: a loop of articulation, situated modeling, environmental realization, and experience; website and repository keep its work readable and maintainable.
How can an expressed personal model organize distributed cognition? Metaphor and self-revision: relational analogy, externalization, contextual contributions, listening/speaking/reading/writing, and a bounded Gödel-machine comparison.
How can philosophical work learn from actual participation? Embodied experimental philosophy: practical and research loops, public works, and revisable boundaries and aims.
How do personal priorities relate to ontology and evidence? Personal-first humanism: concrete persons, constructed descriptions, fallible inquiry, values, and plural methods.
Core image giving the encounter its movement Yinyang and Taiji: ceaseless transformation, mutual grounding, and the Shuang yu, including the Sun–Moon–Earth relation.
Philosophical images developed in essays The stream and time, World, process, and expression, Query rewriting and sublation, Writing a sinthome, and Stealing fire each develop their images within an independently presented argument; there is no separate anthology.
Development of one person's sustaining practice Writing a sinthome: a connected philosophical proposal about personal authorship and agency.
A main axis of understanding: conflict, preference, and inference Preference harness: after reasoning and before finite abstraction, connect view selection, support, and joint consistency, with psychological and formal sources kept distinct.
Relations forming before explicit questions; abduction, prediction, and scientific inquiry Reasoning: event streams, question-relative views, retained sources, candidates, and nested feedback.
Occurrence, reference, experience, and differing update rates The stream and time: temporal indices clarify a conflict without automatically dissolving it.
Speaking, negation, self-description, and retrospective meaning Speaking, self-description, and signifying chains: philosophical relations and bounded formal comparisons.
Consistent support, consistent results, and query rewriting Consistency arguments and query rewriting within the preference-harness essay: formal assumptions and the limits of a sublation analogy.
Finite methods, reducibility, and the cost of abstraction Finite inquiry and abstraction: explanatory gain, approximation, and achievable reasoning.
Process, model, expression, worldly realization, and aesthetics World, process, and expression: how a work both expresses and changes an encounter.
Understanding, available action, response selection, and the cost of support Participation and support: distinctions to investigate in a situated case, not a supplied personal model.
Original philosophical sources and their interpretive limits Philosophical readings: Heraclitus, Yinyang/Taiji, Hegel, Freud, and Lacan.
How can psychological processes be modeled and assessed? Psychological readings: process and evidence, psychological theories and foundations, belief, reasoning, and interaction.
How can a usable environment be understood and realized? Engineering readings: self-study maps, command lines, Git, software design, algorithms, experiments, and physical conditions.

For a first conceptual reading, follow purpose → core views → creation method, then consult the other texts where the question needs them. Formation begins with the usable method and actual materials; it need not wait for completion of a philosophical syllabus. The Sun–Moon–Earth relation belongs within the Yinyang and Taiji image; it is not an independent theoretical prerequisite.

These links resolve within the complete Yinyang directory. Keep its references/docs/ and references/diagrams/ resources with the entrypoint and references when distributing the package; identify any missing material rather than claiming to have read it. The common map remains here; the private index in personal/README.md routes to provenance and private supporting materials, without duplicating the common philosophical accounts.

The encounter and layers diagrams explain the same claims, with matching Chinese encounter and Chinese layers viewers. They are self-contained HTML resources; encounter SVG and layers SVG provide static exports. Diagram directions illustrate relations rather than a mandatory sequence or authority hierarchy. See diagram maintenance for source, validation, and redistribution notices.
